subject: Proctorship agreement for curated testcases and dataset access
messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@retailai.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@retailai.com; legal@retailai.com
Date: 2026-08-23T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proctorship model: access for RetailAI pilot

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. RetailAI is ready to move forward with a short pilot. We have a few constraints on the evaluation assets: we need curated testcases (≈2k examples), a prompt pack for intent coverage, and access to a small seed of our anonymized retail logs. Our legal and procurement teams would like a MAP that limits usage to evaluation only (no derivative models, access window of 30 days, audit logging).

Two asks to start:
- Can Redwood support a proctorship arrangement (someone on your side to intermittently observe in our sandbox)?
- Can you share a mutually acceptable timeline and the specific acceptance gates for the pilot?

I've attached an internal MPA template for you to review.

Attachments: retailai_mpa_template_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Claire Barnes
Head of ML Ops | RetailAI
claire@retailai.com

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@retailai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-23T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proctorship model: access for RetailAI pilot

Claire —

Appreciate the clear constraints. Redwood can absolutely do a time-boxed proctorship and we agree on evaluation-only usage with an enforced access window. High-level proposal from our side: 

1) Access model: ephemeral sandbox in your VPC (customer-managed), with an instrumented proxy from Redwood for auditing. Redwood engineer assigned as proctor will have readonly access to the audit stream and will join two scheduled checkpoints.

2) Data: you provide a zipped prompt pack + testcase manifest; Redwood will ingest to ephemeral storage that is auto-destroyed at window close.

3) Acceptance gates: (a) ingest/format validation, (b) QA run for sample slice (100 cases), (c) final acceptance on precision/recall thresholds we agree on.

Proposed milestone dates (tentative):
- Week 0 (Aug 30): legal / procurement sign-off on MAP
- Week 1 (Sep 6): asset delivery + ingest validation
- Week 2 (Sep 13): QA sample run and tuning
- Week 4 (Sep 27): pilot acceptance / results review

I attached a short checklist we usually use; I also proposed Karthik as the technical lead for the proctorship. Can your legal team share redlines to the MPA template by COB Thursday?

Attachments: redwood_proctorship_checklist.pdf; testcase_manifest_schema.csv

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proctorship model: access for RetailAI pilot

Tessa / Marissa —

Quick technical notes to inform the MAP and operational SOW:
- Ingest: we support CSV/JSONL manifests; manifest must include sample_id, prompt_variant, expected_labels. I attached a minimal schema.
- Sandbox: to keep latency low we recommend a dedicated dedicated small GPU pool with prefix caching enabled; proctorship read streams will be tokenized (no raw payload).
- Audit: Redwood can produce an immutable log (SHA256) and an exportable ledger for the 30-day window.
- Costing: we'll bill pilot usage to the deal ID RDW-3245 under a trial rate; any heavy reingest outside the acceptance scope will be billed.

I'll be the technical point for the two scheduled checkpoints. Also flagging a small requirement: promptpack_sample_v1.zip should not include proprietary customer PII — hashed or synthetic only.

Attachments: testcase_manifest_schema.csv; proctorship_ingest_notes.md

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Claire Barnes <claire@retailai.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@retailai.com; legal@retailai.com
Date: 2026-08-24T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proctorship model: access for RetailAI pilot

Tessa / Karthik —

Thanks — legal asked us to submit a couple of specific redlines:
- Add "proctorship window" clause that limits any Redwood observation to scheduled checkpoints (no continuous access).
- Include a "no-derivative models" clause and explicit destruction timing for ephemeral storage (48 hours post-window).

I've attached redline changes to the MPA and a separate procurement PO template. Will circulate the formal redlines by tomorrow morning.

Attachments: retailai_mpa_redlines_v1.pdf; retailai_po_template.docx

On the PII point — we'll provide hashed identifiers only.

-Claire

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@retailai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proctorship model: access for RetailAI pilot

Claire —

This all looks good and aligns with our standard pilot MAPs. Per your redlines we will:
- Restrict proctorship access to the two scheduled checkpoints and readonly audit stream access only.
- Add explicit no-derivatives language and a 48-hour destroy confirmation for ephemeral storage.

Confirmed action items and owners:
- Legal redlines: RetailAI to send final PDF — Claire / RetailAI Legal (due 2026-08-26)
- MAP sign: Redwood legal to respond with counter-redlines (Priyom) (due 2026-08-27)
- Asset delivery: RetailAI to upload promptpack_sample_v1.zip + testcase_manifest.csv to shared drive (Claire) (due 2026-09-02)
- Ingest & validation: Karthik to run format checks and a 100-case QA slice (due 2026-09-09)
- Acceptance review: joint meeting week of Sep 27 — results and next steps

Attachments we will exchange: retailai_mpa_redlines_v1.pdf; retailai_po_template.docx; promptpack_sample_v1.zip

If that timeline works I'll lock the meeting invites for kickoff and checkpoint 1. Thanks again — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
